The derivation above shows that in the high‑SNR limit the dominant contribution to Sibson’s \(\alpha\)-mutual information comes from the nearest‑neighbour Gaussian component, yielding  

\[
I_\alpha(X;Y) \;\xrightarrow[\text{SNR}\to\infty]{}\; \frac{\alpha}{\alpha-1}\log\!\Bigl(\sum_x p(x)^{1/\alpha}\Bigr)
   \;=\; H_{\beta}(X),\qquad \beta=\frac{1}{\alpha}.
\]

Thus the Rényi‑entropy order that appears is \(\beta = 1/\alpha\), not \(\beta = 1/(1+\alpha)\) as claimed in the proposed solution. Consequently the final answer “\(1/(\alpha+1)\)” is incorrect.
